Daimyo.question: The _____ was Powerful feudal territorial lord in pre-modern Japan.
Daimyo.fact: Daimyo or daimio (大名, daimyō; English: , DIME-yoh; Japanese: [dai.mʲoꜜː] ) were powerful Japanese magnates, feudal lords who, from the 15th century to the early Meiji period in the middle 19th century, ruled most of Japan from their vast hereditary land holdings. From the shugo of the Muromachi period through the Sengoku period to the daimyo of the Edo period, the rank had a long and varied history.
